tools.name: AIS Hub
tools.desc: Raw AIS data feed for technical users requiring direct access to transmission data.

tools.name: Black Sea MoU
tools.desc: Black Sea region port state control inspection records.
tools.opsec: PSC databases are public; no registration required for most MoU portals.
tools.reliability: PSC records cover safety compliance only; they do not address cargo legality or sanctions status.

tools.name: Companies House
tools.desc: UK entity filings including the Persons with Significant Control register. Used to identify ultimate beneficial owners of UK-registered companies.
tools.reliability: Nominee directors are placeholders, not beneficial owners; verify control structure before attribution.

tools.name: Copernicus Open Access Hub
tools.desc: European Space Agency hub for Sentinel-1 SAR imagery. Used to obtain radar returns covering vessel positions during AIS gap periods.
tools.opsec: Treat SAR imagery coordinates as sensitive; handle with the same care as source material.
tools.reliability: SAR returns can be ambiguous; hull size matching requires expert interpretation.

tools.name: EMSA EMCIP
tools.desc: European maritime casualty database. Returns European casualty investigation summaries by vessel name and incident year.

tools.name: Equasis
tools.desc: IMO-endorsed registry providing verified information on commercial vessels including registered owner, ship manager, flag state, class society, and port state control inspection history.
tools.opsec: Equasis requires free registration; use an investigation-dedicated email account. Equasis logs search activity; treat each query as potentially visible. Search from a dedicated research browser profile.
tools.reliability: Ownership data reflects registration records, not verified beneficial ownership. Inspection records show detentions, not convictions; do not conflate the two. Aggregates PSC inspection data across all major MoUs but may lag individual portal updates by days; cross-reference against the originating MoU portal for accuracy. Cross-reference all ownership data against at least two independent registries. Never rely on vessel name alone; always anchor queries to the IMO number.

tools.name: EU Consolidated Sanctions List
tools.desc: Consolidated list of persons, groups, and entities subject to EU financial sanctions.

tools.name: Fleetmon
tools.desc: AIS replay and incident event log. Surfaces crowd-sourced and AIS-derived incident records and prior detentions for a given vessel.
tools.opsec: Download AIS replay data before it ages off free-tier archives.

tools.name: Global Fishing Watch
tools.desc: AIS gap analysis and dark vessel detection. Maintains AIS reception independent of commercial platforms, enabling cross-validation of gap periods.
tools.reliability: A gap visible on Global Fishing Watch but not on a commercial AIS platform indicates selective transmission rather than technical failure. Treat dark vessel behaviour as requiring explanation; it does not confirm illicit activity.

tools.name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks
tools.desc: Searchable database covering Panama Papers, Pandora Papers, and related leak datasets. Used for tracing beneficial ownership through offshore structures.

tools.name: IMO GISIS
tools.desc: IMO Global Integrated Shipping Information System. Houses the marine casualties module containing formal flag-state casualty filings and detention records.
tools.opsec: Save IMO casualty report PDFs immediately; documents are sometimes removed.
tools.reliability: Flag-state reports are sometimes filed late; delay does not always indicate concealment.

tools.name: ITU MARS
tools.desc: Official MMSI-to-flag-state registration database. Used to verify that an MMSI prefix matches the declared flag state.
tools.reliability: An MMSI prefix that does not match the declared flag state is an indicator of identity manipulation.

tools.name: Kpler
tools.desc: Commodity flow tracking and vessel cargo history. Returns declared cargo type and volume by voyage.

tools.name: Lloyd's List Intelligence
tools.desc: Vessel ownership history and corporate links. Used to identify previous owners and flag-state changes that may signal restructuring.
tools.opsec: Never query paid databases using a target-linked email.

tools.name: MAIB Casualty Reports
tools.desc: UK Marine Accident Investigation Branch formal investigation reports.
tools.opsec: Do not contact flag-state authorities from a byline-linked email address.

tools.name: MarineTraffic
tools.cost: Free tier; paid tiers for historical playback and additional features.
tools.desc: Real-time AIS feed and historical playback. The default first stop for vessel position and voyage history.
tools.opsec: MarineTraffic logs IP addresses. Route queries through a VPN. Avoid querying the same MMSI repeatedly from the same IP; rate-limit manually. Use a dedicated browser profile for maritime investigations.
tools.reliability: AIS position reflects transponder data, not verified GPS, and can be manually entered incorrectly. AIS relay stations can introduce a position lag of up to 30 minutes. Reception gaps are common in remote ocean areas; coverage is not global.

tools.name: NTSB Marine Casualty Reports
tools.desc: US National Transportation Safety Board marine casualty investigation reports.
tools.opsec: Do not contact flag-state authorities from a byline-linked email address.

tools.name: OFAC SDN List
tools.desc: US Treasury Specially Designated Nationals list. Returns US-designated vessels with IMO numbers and supports filtering by sanctions program.
tools.opsec: Segregate sanctions database queries from your primary research profile. Download OFAC SDN updates locally; the list changes without notice.
tools.reliability: Historical sanctions listings may predate vessel name recycling; confirm current designation status. Vessels with sanctioned-entity names that are distinct registered ships exist; verify by IMO.

tools.name: OpenCorporates
tools.cost: Free web search; paid tiers for API access.
tools.desc: Largest open database of company registrations across 140+ jurisdictions. Used for tracing corporate layers and identifying directors and shareholders.
tools.reliability: Identically named companies in different jurisdictions exist; confirm registration numbers. Historical ownership records change frequently after incidents.

tools.name: OpenSanctions
tools.cost: Free web access; paid tiers for bulk and API.
tools.desc: Cross-reference platform for screening individuals and entities against consolidated sanctions lists from multiple jurisdictions.

tools.name: Paris MoU
tools.desc: European and North Atlantic port state control inspection database. Publishes annual flag state performance rankings used to assess detention risk.
tools.opsec: PSC databases are public; no registration required for most MoU portals.
tools.reliability: High deficiency counts in some MoU regions reflect stricter inspection regimes, not worse vessels. Flag state ranking data reflects aggregate fleet performance, not individual vessel quality. PSC records cover safety compliance only; they do not address cargo legality or sanctions status.

tools.name: SkyTruth
tools.desc: Satellite-based vessel detection and dark ship alerts. Used to surface vessels operating without AIS transmission.

tools.name: TankerTrackers
tools.desc: Specialist STS event tracking and satellite integration. Returns logged STS events with date, location, and partner vessel.
tools.opsec: Never request satellite tasking from a byline-linked account.

tools.name: Tokyo MoU
tools.desc: Asia-Pacific port state control inspection database. Publishes annual flag state performance rankings used to assess detention risk.
tools.opsec: PSC databases are public; no registration required for most MoU portals.
tools.reliability: High deficiency counts in some MoU regions reflect stricter inspection regimes, not worse vessels. Flag state ranking data reflects aggregate fleet performance, not individual vessel quality. PSC records cover safety compliance only; they do not address cargo legality or sanctions status.

tools.name: UK OFSI Sanctions List
tools.desc: UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation consolidated list. Used alongside OFAC and EU lists for full sanctions screening coverage.

tools.name: UN Comtrade
tools.desc: Trade flow data used to cross-check declared cargo volumes against reporter-country and commodity-code declarations.

tools.name: UN Consolidated Sanctions List
tools.desc: United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list. Confirms designation status across all UN sanctions regimes.

tools.name: US Coast Guard PSIX
tools.desc: US Coast Guard Port State Information Exchange. Independent inspection records for vessels operating in US waters, not always captured by other MoUs.
tools.opsec: PSC databases are public; no registration required for most MoU portals.
tools.reliability: PSC records cover safety compliance only; they do not address cargo legality or sanctions status.

tools.name: VesselFinder
tools.desc: Alternative AIS source used to cross-reference position data and flag discrepancies in primary feeds.

tools.name: VIIRS Boat Detection (NASA FIRMS)
tools.desc: Nighttime lights data from NASA. Provides a third independent position signal for nocturnal AIS gaps in known fishing or transfer zones.

tools.name: Wayback Machine
tools.desc: Internet Archive snapshot service. Used to preserve sanctions designation pages, official report pages, and key company pages against later removal.

tools.name: Weather Underground History
tools.desc: Historical hourly meteorological records by station and date. Used to reconstruct wind, visibility, and sea-state conditions at incident time.
tools.reliability: Verify proximity of the weather station to the incident coordinates before treating records as evidence.

tools.name: Windward
tools.desc: Commercial AIS risk platform with AI-flagged STS events and behavioural risk scoring.

tools.name: World-Check (Refinitiv)
tools.desc: PEP and sanctions screening database for individuals and entities.
tools.opsec: Never query paid databases using a target-linked email.

tools.name: Merlin Bird ID
tools.desc: Cornell Lab audio identification app that maps identified bird species against their geographic range, used for acoustic geolocation in recordings.
tools.reliability: Species range data reduces but does not eliminate locational ambiguity; cosmopolitan species appear across wide ranges.

tools.name: Hive Moderation AI Detector
tools.cost: Paid; per-file pricing via dashboard or API.
tools.desc: Multi-modal AI-generated content detector covering images, video, and audio with per-file confidence scores across generation classes.
tools.opsec: Confirm the platform's data retention policy before uploading evidential media. Record the exact API build version used at time of analysis.
tools.reliability: Treat any single detector result as a corroborating signal, not a conclusion; layer with at least one additional detector.

tools.name: Optic
tools.cost: Paid; web interface and API access.
tools.desc: AI-generated image and video detector cited in Reuters Institute and GIJN comparative testing; returns detection scores with visual overlay highlighting flagged regions.
tools.opsec: Confirm the platform's data retention policy before uploading evidential media.
tools.reliability: Cited in published comparative evaluations (Reuters Institute; GIJN). Detectors trained on specific generation models may not recognise output from newer architectures.

tools.name: Illuminarty
tools.desc: Image-focused AI probability scorer used as a cross-check source alongside higher-confidence commercial detectors.
tools.reliability: Use as a secondary cross-check; heavy JPEG compression or low-resolution crops reduce accuracy across all detectors.

tools.name: InVID / WeVerify
tools.desc: Browser extension providing metadata inspection, reverse image search, and keyframe extraction for video verification workflows.

tools.name: C2PA Content Credentials Inspector
tools.desc: Reads embedded C2PA provenance metadata in media files where watermarking has been applied at capture; documents whether credentials are present, absent, or stripped.
tools.opsec: C2PA credentials are frequently stripped by social media platforms on upload; their absence is not evidence of fabrication.
tools.reliability: Absence of credentials does not indicate AI generation. Presence confirms only that provenance was recorded at capture, not that content is authentic.

tools.name: FAA Aircraft Registry
tools.desc: Authoritative US N-number registration search with ownership history and airworthiness records maintained by the Federal Aviation Administration.
tools.opsec: Route all registry searches through a VPN to avoid alerting subjects. Document the registration date, jurisdiction, and source URL for every record retrieved.
tools.reliability: Trust and LLC registrations are standard US aviation practice and do not indicate concealment without additional indicators. Historical registry data may lag real ownership changes by weeks.

tools.name: ADS-B Exchange
tools.desc: Unfiltered global flight tracking platform that does not honour operator removal requests, making it the primary source for investigators tracking sensitive aircraft.
tools.opsec: Use as the primary tracking source precisely because operators cannot suppress data.
tools.reliability: ADS-B gaps over ocean or in airspace with limited receiver coverage do not indicate intentional flight suppression. (ADS-B Exchange platform documentation, adsbexchange.com/what-is-the-exchange)

tools.name: FlightAware
tools.cost: Free tier available; operators can pay for suppression.
tools.desc: Global flight tracking platform with ownership lookup; operators can pay to suppress visibility, so cross-reference against ADS-B Exchange for sensitive investigations.
tools.opsec: Do not rely on FlightAware alone; operators can pay to remove their aircraft from results.
tools.reliability: Operator suppression is a documented feature; absence of a record does not confirm a flight did not occur.

tools.name: Icarus Flights
tools.desc: Transponder data, ownership records, and area-based search designed specifically for investigative use; introduced by C4ADS at GIJC21.

tools.name: Rzjets / PlaneLogger
tools.desc: Community-maintained databases of business jet registrations and ownership records across jurisdictions, used for multi-jurisdiction registration history searches.
tools.reliability: Identical company names in different jurisdictions can produce erroneous ownership linkages without MSN verification.

tools.name: OCCRP Aleph
tools.desc: Cross-source search platform covering 340 million public entities across 141 countries, including persons-of-interest datasets, sanctions lists, and gazette records.
tools.opsec: Search from a research account with no personal identifiers. Route queries through a VPN.
tools.reliability: Database hits are starting points, not conclusions; the named party may be a nominee. Treat any match as requiring source-document verification.

tools.name: GLEIF Global LEI Index
tools.desc: Open corporate ownership database answering who-owns-whom via Level 2 LEI relationship records connecting direct and ultimate parent entities across jurisdictions.
tools.reliability: LEI coverage is strongest in regulated financial sectors; privately held or small entities may lack LEI records.

tools.name: LittleSis
tools.desc: US-focused relationship database mapping interlocks between corporate boards, political donors, and government officials.

tools.name: IPinfo.io
tools.cost: Free tier; paid tiers for higher API volume.
tools.desc: IP geolocation, ASN, organisation, VPN and proxy flag lookup with API access; the standard first stop for IP attribution.
tools.opsec: Never query a target IP directly from an operational device; route all lookups through a VPN. Treat city-level geolocation as approximate; country and ASN attribution are significantly more reliable.
tools.reliability: Cloud provider IP ownership (AWS, Google Cloud, Cloudflare) identifies the data centre operator, not the customer. Dynamic IPs are reassigned frequently; document the retrieval timestamp for every lookup.

tools.name: Shodan
tools.cost: Paid; free account provides limited results.
tools.desc: Internet-wide service-banner search engine indexing open ports, certificates, and device banners from IP addresses; essential for infrastructure fingerprinting.
tools.opsec: Shodan logs all queries; searching for a target IP reveals your interest to the platform. Route lookups through a VPN. Note the scan date on all results, as banners reflect the date of last Shodan scan, not the current state.
tools.reliability: Shared hosting environments place hundreds of unrelated websites on a single IP; co-hosting alone is insufficient for attribution.

tools.name: Censys
tools.cost: Free tier available; paid tiers for API access.
tools.desc: Certificate transparency and service data indexed by IP; complementary to Shodan for mapping shared SSL certificates and infrastructure across IP ranges.
tools.opsec: Censys queries are logged; route lookups through a VPN.

tools.name: BGP.tools
tools.desc: ASN and BGP prefix lookup providing routing history and peering data for network infrastructure attribution.

tools.name: SecurityTrails
tools.cost: Free tier; paid tiers for API access.
tools.desc: Passive DNS history database linking domains to historical IP addresses and vice versa; used to pivot from a single IP to related domains hosted on the same infrastructure.
tools.reliability: Historical DNS records reflect the date range indexed; recent changes may not be captured immediately.

tools.name: FreeSound
tools.cost: Free; account required for file download, not for search or preview.
tools.desc: Community audio database with Creative Commons-licensed reference recordings searchable by environment type, geography, and acoustic tag. Used for acoustic environment comparison in audio forensics workflows.
tools.opsec: Use a dedicated research account; do not use a personal account for investigation-related searches. Never upload evidentiary recordings to FreeSound; uploads are public by default. Search queries are logged server-side.
tools.reliability: Obtain at least two reference recordings from independent sources before treating an environment match as corroborating. A single-source match is insufficient for evidential purposes.

tools.name: NOAA Weather Radio Archive
tools.cost: Free, open access, no account required.
tools.desc: US government public archive of weather broadcast recordings with verified timestamps and transmitter location data. Used as a reference source for ENF comparison and acoustic environment practice exercises.
tools.opsec: Public government database; no registration required. Standard research compartmentalisation applies to any browser-based access.
tools.reliability: Verified timestamps and transmitter metadata make this a reliable ENF reference source for the Eastern Interconnection and other US grid regions. Coverage limited to US transmitters.

tools.name: ENF Toolkit
tools.desc: Bellingcat's open-source Python toolkit for automated ENF extraction and database comparison. Runs locally via command line. Used where manual Audacity ENF extraction lacks sufficient resolution.
tools.opsec: Runs entirely on the analyst's device; no data leaves the research environment. Verify package integrity against the Bellingcat GitHub repository before installation.
tools.reliability: Requires intermediate technical proficiency to install and operate. ENF database coverage varies by country and grid region; a mismatch does not confirm fabrication where database gaps exist. Document the database version and tolerance parameters used in every analysis.

tools.name: Audacity
tools.desc: Free, open-source waveform editor and spectrogram analyser. Primary tool for ENF extraction, acoustic environment profiling, and event-sound segmentation in audio forensics workflows.
tools.opsec: Runs entirely on the analyst's device; no data leaves the research environment during spectrogram or ENF analysis. Use a dedicated research browser profile for any online documentation lookups.
tools.reliability: Spectrogram resolution is limited by FFT size; set FFT to 4096 or higher for ENF band visibility. Insufficient for high-resolution spectral work where Adobe Audition's display is required.

tools.name: Adobe Audition
tools.cost: Standalone from $22.99/mo (annual, billed monthly). Included in Creative Cloud Pro from $34.99/mo.
tools.desc: Commercial waveform editor with higher-resolution spectral frequency display than Audacity. Used for high-resolution spectrogram work where Audacity resolution is insufficient for the target signal.
tools.opsec: Disable cloud sync before opening any sensitive file. Cloud sync is enabled by default and will upload file content to Adobe servers if not explicitly turned off before opening the recording.
tools.reliability: Trial tier is adequate for spectrogram analysis; full subscription not required for basic forensic audio work. Cloud sync behaviour must be verified after every application update as settings can reset.

tools.name: SonicVisualiser
tools.desc: Layer-based audio annotation and spectrogram analysis tool favoured in forensic workflows for producing annotated exports.

tools.name: xeno-canto
tools.desc: Global repository of bird and wildlife sound recordings used for comparative species identification in acoustic geolocation workflows.
tools.opsec: Fauna recordings from online platforms may carry metadata from a location different from the audio's geographic origin.
